title: Fix/62341 large log guard
body:
Suggested follow up to : [this PR](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/62388)
Adds a large-log warning guard in Task Instance Logs to prevent browser freeze by default and require explicit user opt-in before rendering very large log output in-browser.
